summary: Blackstone Mortgage Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $450 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 under an indenture with guarantor subsidiaries and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as trustee. The notes were privately placed to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying existing secured indebtedness. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event; this is a routine debt financing. No advisory or board recommendation provided. Structure includes optional redemption and change-of-control provisions.
